reason: Site profile raises the per-request image limit for multi-image agent compaction, whose clients resend history images. The display carveout lender (spark-attic 0.1.4, 2,044 MiB) is active on all four nodes, adding headroom for the per-request host memory spike.
qualification: Site change carried on the deployment fork's site branch; not serving-qualified. Host memory per in-flight image follows source pixels, not tokens (experiments/2026-10-26-site-landmines: 19 MiB at 1,302 px, 61-74 MiB at 12 MP); the VLLM_MAX_IMAGE_PIXELS=16777216 cap is unchanged and still rejects oversized images before decoding.
